content.title: Performance Food Group (NYSE:PFGC) Exceeds Q3 CY2025 Expectations
content.summary: Food distribution giant Performance Food Group (NYSE:PFGC) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $17.08 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $68 billion at the midpoint came in 1.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.18 per share was 2.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
